units.text: Article 53 of the 1969 Vienna Convention states that a treaty is void if it conflicts with a peremptory norm at the time of its conclusion.

citations.title: Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties (1969)

judgement.reason: The passage quotes Article 53 as stating a treaty is void if, at the time of its conclusion, it conflicts with a peremptory norm of general international law.

units.text: The claim asserts that treaties are voided only after entry into force, which contradicts the treaty's explicit reference to the time of conclusion.
